_comment: Copy to the codex-hop data directory as config.json and edit. On Windows that is %LOCALAPPDATA%/codex-hop/config.json. Every section is optional: with no config at all the router relays traffic and supports /dsk and /gpt, with MCP disabled.
_maxDsContextBytes: Above this decoded request size the router refuses to forward the turn to DeepSeek and explains why in the chat instead. Nothing is truncated. Override once with '/dsk force'.
_maxMcpIterations: Hard cap on router-executed tool steps inside a single user turn. Each step re-sends the whole context.
_requireConfirmation: Two-phase write: preview first, then '/send-ok' to perform it. This is the default and you can omit the key entirely. Only an explicit false turns it off, which makes a write run the moment the model asks for it.

mcpServers._comment: Servers are matched by name against [mcp_servers.*] in the Codex config.toml; command, args, env and cwd come from there. Only the tools listed here are published, and only if the server reports annotations.readOnlyHint === true.

_writeTools: Write-capable MCP tools, listed by exact name. Disabled by default. Each call is guarded by the confirmation handshake above.
